1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

- **[Biotech]** **Targeting MMEJ with RP-3467** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42773059/)
  - Preclinical data show that RP-3467, a selective small-molecule inhibitor of the DNA polymerase theta (Polθ) ATPase domain, blocks microhomology-mediated end joining and synergizes with PARP inhibitors in homologous recombination-deficient models.
  - Evaluation in a clinical setting highlighted a response in a gBRCA1 ovarian cancer patient with an acquired PARPi resistance mutation in TP53BP1.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

- **[Biotech]** **Alkermes reports orexin proof-of-concept in ADHD** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/orexin-adhd-cue-urticaria-/830847/)
  - ALKS 7290, an orexin-2 receptor amplifier discovered by Alkermes, demonstrated dose-dependent, clinically meaningful improvements on exploratory symptom severity measures in an early-stage ADHD trial.
  - A Phase 2 trial is currently underway, with results anticipated in 2027.

- **[Biotech]** **Viking reports maintenance phase results for VK2735** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/viking-obesity-drug-maintenance-study-results/831004/)
  - In a Phase 2 trial of 180 participants with obesity, patients receiving Viking Therapeutics' dual-acting drug VK2735 maintained up to 90% of their weight loss after transitioning from weekly injections to biweekly or monthly maintenance regimens over 12 weeks.

- **[Biotech]** **Vertex announces Phase 2b AMPLIFIED results for inaxaplin** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2102367676425437639)
  - Vertex Pharmaceuticals reported positive results from the Phase 2b AMPLIFIED study evaluating inaxaplin in additional populations of patients with APOL1-mediated kidney disease.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

- **[Big Pharma]** **Amgen meets primary endpoint in Sjögren’s Phase 3 trial** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/amgen-dazodalibep-sjogrens-syndrome-study-results/831042/)
  - Amgen’s dazodalibep met its primary objective in the first of two Phase 3 trials for Sjögren’s syndrome, achieving a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in disease activity at 48 weeks.
  - Therapeutic effects emerged as early as four weeks; the drug maintained a generally mild-to-moderate safety profile without unexpected blood clot or opportunistic infection imbalances.

- **[Biotech]** **Celldex reports Phase 3 data for barzolvolimab in urticaria** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/celldex-barzolvolimab-urticaria-study-results-embarq/830982/)
  - Celldex released results from two Phase 3 studies evaluating barzolvolimab in chronic spontaneous urticaria.
  - While the drug was generally reported as well-tolerated across roughly 2,400 total treated patients, investor focus centered on two reported cases of anaphylaxis in a treatment arm.

- **[Biotech]** **Ionis announces positive topline Phase 3 FUSION results** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2102368850985586815)
  - Ionis Pharmaceuticals reported positive topline results from the Phase 3 FUSION study of ulefnersen, marking a milestone as a potential disease-modifying treatment for FUS-ALS.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

- **[Biotech]** **FDA lifts clinical hold on simufilam** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2102368444968751480)
  - Cassava Sciences (fka SAVA) announced that the FDA lifted the clinical hold on simufilam, clearing the path to initiate a Phase 2a study in tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC)-related epilepsy.

- **FDA accepts wearable sensor foot drop metrics under ISTAND** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fda-accepts-wearable-sensor-derived-foot-drop-metrics-under-istand-longitudinal-outcome-measures)
  - The FDA's ISTAND program accepted a letter of intent for a wearable sensor-derived digital outcome measure quantifying foot drop severity and gait impact in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 1A (CMT1A), marking the first digital health technology accepted for a rare neurological condition under the program.

5. **Business & Strategy**

- **Empower Pharmacy warned over 503A violations** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/warning-letters/empower-clinic-services-llc-dba-empower-pharmacy-738238-09182026)
  - Following a November 2025 inspection, the FDA issued a warning letter to Empower Clinic Services (Empower Pharmacy) for producing drug products that failed to meet the statutory exemptions under section 503A of the FD&C Act.

- **kdc/one Chatsworth cited for manufacturing violations** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/warning-letters/kdcone-chatsworth-inc-733205-09082026)
  - The FDA issued a warning letter to kdc/one Chatsworth detailing significant over-the-counter drug manufacturing violations observed during a facility inspection.
